author: ThePredator_1
body:
Hello, My Name is Zac Cooper aka "ThePredator_1" I got banned over a year ago for hacking. A friend showed me how and It took the fun out of the game. I am sorry I hacked and promise to never do it again. Avicus was my all time favorite server and I would really like to get to play again soon. Please let me know what I can do in order to play again.
Thanks
